title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
神圣又肃穆的交接仪式开始。大祭司从绘有各种复杂鸟兽花纹的青铜柱上取下雨神特拉洛克的面具。这是一张通体呈现出翡翠般碧绿色的面具，面具表面布满细密的裂纹，充满了岁月冲刷的痕迹和神圣的气息。大祭司看着它叹息一声，用异常珍重的状态将其交到了对面的战士修尔斯手中。而卢克此时像是一个背后灵般，共享着战士修尔斯的视角，但却无法发声，也无法做出任何举动。他跟随着战士修尔斯离开了阿兹特克帝国的都城特诺奇蒂特兰，这片众神注视之地，随后一路北上，来到了现在美利坚所在的北美洲。在16世纪初这里还是一片净土。为了逃避追杀，伤势不轻的修尔斯在自己倒下之前，将雨神特拉洛克的面具交给了一个跟他们阿兹特克交好的大部落。随后这名勇猛又坚韧的美洲虎战士就这样死去了。而似乎是为了履行自己的誓言般，卢克发现故事到这里并没有结束。他的视角从附在战士修尔斯身上，变为附在了那张神圣又威严的面具上面。当地部落的大祭司妥善保管了这件圣器，并且把修尔斯死后身上唯一的遗物，那柄曾经向神灵献上过祭品的锋利黑曜石匕首，送给了他的儿子。时间就这样平淡过去了几百年。虽然部落之间偶尔也会发生战争，但这个名为苏的印第安部落始终屹立不倒，在这片土地上繁荣壮大着。直到。。。。。。那群曾经的逃难者发展壮大，并且建国之后，开始了对他们惨无人道的屠杀。当时的苏族首领试图带领身边的族人反抗，但最终，他们也失败了，身死族灭。那块历经数百年，仍旧保存完好的雨神特拉洛克面具，几近辗转，落入了一个白人军官手里。这名军官似乎发现这块面具的不同寻常，研究了它许久，最终因为要去参加战争，将它和一个笔记本存放在美国当时最早成立的银行之一，美国第一国家银行。“呼......”故事进行到这里，卢克的视角猛地从那张被放进银行保险柜里的面具身上脱离出来。他双手撑着地，大口喘着气，发现自己刚才在梦中看到的那些记忆正在迅速淡化。只有最后偌大的苏族被美国人屠灭，以及那张经历数百年，仍保存完好的雨神特拉洛克面具让他印象深刻。而在一旁，看着卢克这副汗如雨下、似乎随时会猝死的夸张反应，拉他进来的印第安少年有点慌，用本地方言小声向他姐姐问道：“米娜，你不会在药草里掺了其他东西吧，这个白人怎么会变成这样？”“没有啊，我都是按照妈妈平时祭祀的流程来的......”假扮女巫的印第安少女米娜也有些不知所措，生怕这个白人等下死在他们这里。那样的话他们的麻烦就大了。而卢克这边，在缓了一会之后，他的意识终于从那个离奇的梦境中完全脱离了出来，大脑恢复了正常思考。首先，现在可以确定了，他的特殊能力肯定来自于母亲留下的这串黑曜石手链。而这串黑曜石手链似乎是源于几百年前的那名美洲虎战士修尔斯，是由对方手里的黑曜石匕首改的。其次他几次三番梦到那块雨神特拉洛克的面具，仿佛冥冥之中有人想要他去把那件阿兹特克帝国的圣物取回来。“会是修尔斯遗留下来的执念吗？”看过不少好莱坞大片的卢克心中隐隐有所猜测。

他抬起手撸起衣袖，表情有些复杂地看着自己右手手腕上的黑曜石手链。这一幕恰好被帐篷里都已经准备跑路的姐弟两看见了。两人相互对视一眼，眼神都有些不可思议，目光在卢克身上来回扫视，像是在确定什么。最后，印第安少年像是回想起了什么，从衣服口袋里掏出手机，点开他最近加入的一个line聊天群。里面是各路网站大神分享的各种劲爆消息。其中最劲爆的，要数今天发生在纽约布鲁克林大桥上，不知道是真是假的超凡大战。有一名黑客技术不错的好事网友甚至用面容捕捉技术，还原了视频里面那个强大灰巨人的外貌，并且在网络上搜索到了他的绝大部分信息。其中就包括卢克.邓肯的名字，所上大学，工作，家庭背景，以及被妻子绿了，还净身出户的悲惨经历。“嘶嘶......”看着聊天群里还原出来的照片，印第安少年终于确定了，他们面前这个看起来有点落魄的白人大叔就是今天纽约布鲁克林大桥上的主角。而且这还不是最重要的。最重要的是。。。。。。印第安少年目光下移，看向了网友总结的灰巨人家庭信息那一栏。上面赫然写着对方的母亲是一名印第安女性，名字叫索菲亚。而这个名字，印第安少年已经不止一次从他母亲嘴里听过了，因为这是他母亲的亲姐姐。“所以？？！”两相映证之下，排除所有的不可能，只剩下一个可能了。印第安少年惊喜瞪大眼睛，和身边同样看到了手机内容的姐姐对视一眼。两人快速跑到卢克面前，像是找到了靠山般，抱着他眼含热泪，动情地喊了出来：“卢克哥哥，你终于来了。”卢克.邓肯：“？？？”卢克一脸懵逼的表情。......“所以，我妈妈索菲亚和你们妈妈琳达是亲姐妹？？”十几分钟后，在经过一番复杂的沟通，卢克脑子有些懵懵地接受了这个信息。“嗯嗯。”印第安少年罗伯特，和卸下伪装后、长相意外精致的印第安少女米娜小鸡啄米般点头。说着，怕卢克不信，罗伯特还特意从手机相册里翻找出一张他从家里客厅拍的老照片。照片上是一大一小两个印第安女孩牵手在湖边嬉戏的场景。虽然是很久之前拍的，但卢克还是一眼认了出来，那个大许多的印第安女孩就是他母亲索菲亚，眉眼轮廓一模一样。“好吧。”这下他彻底信了。面前这两个在搞诈骗的活宝确实是他的表弟表妹。......
content_en:
The sacred and solemn handover ceremony began.The high priest removed the mask of the rain god Tlaloc from a bronze pillar painted with various intricate patterns of birds and animals.This is a mask that is emerald green all over. The surface of the mask is covered with fine cracks, full of traces of the erosion of time and a sacred aura.The high priest looked at it and sighed, then handed it over to the warrior Sholes on the opposite side with unusual treasure.Luke was like a ghost at this time, sharing the perspective of the warrior Sholes, but he was unable to speak or make any moves.He followed the warrior Xuelus to leave Tenochtitlan, the capital of the Aztec Empire, the land where the gods watched, and then went all the way north to North America, where the United States is now.At the beginning of the 16th century, this place was still a pure land.In order to escape pursuit, Sholes, who was seriously injured, handed over the mask of Tlaloc, the rain god, to a large tribe that was friendly with the Aztecs before he fell.Then this brave and tenacious Jaguar warrior died.And as if to fulfill his oath, Luke discovered that the story did not end here.His perspective changed from being attached to the warrior Sholes to being attached to that sacred and majestic mask.The high priest of the local tribe took good care of the sacred artifact and gave it to his son, the only relic of Sholes' body after his death, the sharp obsidian dagger that had been offered as a sacrifice to the gods.Time passed like this for hundreds of years.Although there are occasional wars between tribes, the Indian tribe named Su has always stood firm and prospered on this land.until......The group of former refugees grew and grew, and after the founding of the country, they began to brutally massacre them.The leader of the Sioux tribe at that time tried to lead the tribesmen around him to resist, but in the end, they also failed and died.The mask of Tlaloc, the rain god, which had survived hundreds of years and was still well-preserved, almost fell into the hands of a white officer.The officer seemed to find the mask unusual and studied it for a long time. Finally, because he was going to participate in the war, he stored it and a notebook in the First National Bank of the United States, one of the earliest banks established in the United States at that time."Huh..." At this point in the story, Luke's perspective suddenly broke away from the mask that was placed in the bank safe.He put his hands on the ground and gasped for air, realizing that the memories he had just seen in his dream were quickly fading.Only the last large Sioux tribe was massacred by the Americans, and the mask of Tlaloc, the rain god, that was still well preserved after hundreds of years, impressed him deeply.On the side, looking at Luke's exaggerated reaction of sweating like rain and seeming to die suddenly at any time, the Indian boy who pulled him in was a little panicked and asked his sister in a low voice in the local dialect: "Mina, you didn't mix other things in the medicinal herbs, how could this white man become like this?" "No, I followed my mother's usual sacrificial procedures..." Mina, the Indian girl pretending to be a witch, was also at a loss, fearing that the white man would die in their place later.Then they would be in big trouble.As for Luke, after a while, his consciousness finally completely separated from the bizarre dream, and his brain returned to normal thinking.First of all, it is now certain that his special abilities must come from the obsidian bracelet left by his mother.This obsidian bracelet seems to have originated from the jaguar warrior Sholes hundreds of years ago, and was modified from the obsidian dagger in the opponent's hand.Secondly, he dreamed of the mask of the rain god Tlaloc several times, as if someone in the dark wanted him to get back the sacred object of the Aztec Empire."Could it be the obsession left behind by Sholes?" Luke, who has watched many Hollywood blockbusters, had a vague guess in his mind.

He raised his hand to roll up his sleeves and looked at the obsidian bracelet on his right wrist with a complicated expression.This scene happened to be seen by the two siblings in the tent who were already preparing to run away.The two of them looked at each other in disbelief, their eyes scanning Luke back and forth, as if they were confirming something.Finally, the Indian boy seemed to recall something, took out his mobile phone from his pocket, and clicked on a line chat group he had recently joined.It contains all kinds of breaking news shared by the masters of various websites.The most exciting one was the extraordinary battle that took place on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York City today. I don’t know whether it was real or fake.A netizen with good hacking skills even used facial capture technology to restore the appearance of the powerful gray giant in the video, and searched most of his information on the Internet.These include Luke Duncan's name, the university he attended, his job, his family background, and his tragic experience of being cheated on by his wife and then leaving the house."Hiss..." Looking at the restored photos in the chat group, the Indian teenagers finally confirmed that the somewhat downtrodden white uncle in front of them was the protagonist on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York today.And that's not even the most important thing.The most important thing is......The Indian boy lowered his gaze and looked at the column where the gray giant's family information was summarized by netizens.It clearly states that the other party's mother is an Indian woman named Sophia.The Indian boy had heard this name from his mother more than once, because this was his mother's biological sister."So??!" Under the two conditions, all impossibilities were eliminated, leaving only one possibility.The Indian boy's eyes widened in surprise, and he looked at his sister next to him who also saw the contents of the phone.The two of them quickly ran to Luke, as if they had found support, hugged him with tears in their eyes, and shouted emotionally: "Brother Luke, you are finally here." Luke Duncan: "???" Luke looked confused...."So, my mother Sophia and your mother Linda are biological sisters??" Ten minutes later, after some complicated communication, Luke accepted the information in a daze."Yeah." Robert, the Indian boy, and Mina, the surprisingly delicate-looking Indian girl who took off her disguise, nodded like chickens pecking at rice.As he said this, fearing that Luke wouldn't believe it, Robert deliberately dug out an old photo he took from the living room on his phone from the photo album on his phone.The photo showed a scene of two Indian girls, one big and one small, holding hands and playing by the lake.Although the photo was taken a long time ago, Luke recognized it at a glance. The much older Indian girl was his mother, Sophia, with exactly the same eyebrows and eyes."Okay." This time he completely believed it.The two fraudsters in front of him were indeed his cousins....
